# Performance Requirement Skill

1. Read the source artifacts first.
2. Extract only stated values.
3. Preserve source reference and excerpt.
4. Mark missing values as `MISSING`.
5. Mark ambiguous/conflicting values as `NEEDS_CLARIFICATION`.
6. Never convert AI recommendations or observations into approved requirements.
7. Produce targeted open questions.
8. Do not finalise a plan while mandatory requirements remain unresolved.
